changelog: the shared factory-default credentials were removed; this build ships unprovisioned, with no device credentials configured

in this build the local API is unencrypted, over-the-air updates and the web interface are unauthenticated, and the fallback Wi-Fi hotspot is open; if you require authenticated access, build your own firmware with unique secrets. Automatic per-device credential setup is planned but not yet implemented
Supersedes v1.0.0-led-preview. Preview channel: not hardware verified. A security advisory will follow.
known_issues: FanTRIAC is not included in this firmware. It is a separate compile-only / advanced-preview build (mains-voltage TRIAC dimming), not stable, and remains gated by PACKAGE-TRIAC-001 plus the COMPLIANCE-001-RESOLUTION-001 experimental-lane preconditions (COMPLIANCE-001 closed by market posture: the S360-320 board is never placed on the market; self-build open-source only).
